title: Data Analyst
typical_interview_questions: Explain the difference between a LEFT JOIN and an INNER JOIN in SQL.
How would you handle missing or corrupt data in a dataset before analysis?
Can you describe a time you translated complex data findings into business insights?
What is the difference between descriptive and predictive analytics?
How do you design a SQL query to find the second highest salary in an employees table?
sample_JD_text: We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our team. You will write complex SQL queries, analyze user behavior, build dashboards in Tableau/PowerBI, and translate analytical insights into concrete business suggestions. Must be strong with SQL, python, and statistical basics.

title: ML Engineer
typical_interview_questions: What is overfitting, and how do you prevent it in a deep learning model?
Explain the bias-variance tradeoff.
How do you deploy a machine learning model to a production environment?
Describe how a Transformer-based language model works under the hood.
What metrics would you use to evaluate a highly imbalanced classification dataset?
sample_JD_text: Seeking an ML Engineer to build, scale, and deploy predictive models. You will design machine learning pipelines using PyTorch and Scikit-Learn, optimize models for inference, and work closely with backend engineers to integrate model APIs. Prior experience with Docker and model tracking tools is a plus.

title: Frontend Developer
typical_interview_questions: Explain how React's Virtual DOM works.
What is the difference between state and props in React?
How do you optimize a React web page that is sluggish or has unnecessary re-renders?
Explain CSS box model and Flexbox/Grid layouts.
What is the difference between local storage, session storage, and cookies?
sample_JD_text: Join us as a Frontend Developer to build beautiful, responsive user interfaces. You will translate wireframes and designs into high-quality React code, optimize web performance, and implement state management patterns using TypeScript.

title: Backend Developer
typical_interview_questions: Describe the HTTP status codes 200, 201, 400, 401, 403, and 500.
How do you design a database schema to handle a one-to-many relationship?
Explain the difference between synchronous and asynchronous request handling in FastAPI.
What is database indexing and how does it improve query performance?
How do you handle API authentication and secure sensitive endpoints?
sample_JD_text: We are seeking a Backend Developer to build scalable backend services. You will design database schemas, write robust endpoints using FastAPI, optimize SQL queries, and deploy web applications to AWS using Docker containerization.

title: DevOps Engineer
typical_interview_questions: Explain the lifecycle of a Docker container.
How would you setup a secure multi-stage CI/CD pipeline?
What is Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and why is it useful?
How do you troubleshoot a server that has run out of disk space or memory?
Explain the difference between horizontal and vertical scaling.
sample_JD_text: Looking for a DevOps Engineer to manage our infrastructure and deployment pipelines. You will write CI/CD pipelines, configure Docker containers, monitor server health, and manage cloud services on AWS using Terraform.

title: Data Scientist
typical_interview_questions: Explain the difference between a t-test and a chi-square test.
How do you design an A/B test for a new feature implementation?
What is the difference between L1 (Lasso) and L2 (Ridge) regularization?
How would you explain a random forest classifier to a non-technical stakeholder?
How do you handle collinearity in a regression model?
sample_JD_text: Join our team as a Data Scientist. You will formulate business questions, design statistical tests, write Python/SQL queries to extract insights, and present data-driven narratives to senior management. Experience with predictive modeling is key.

title: QA Engineer
typical_interview_questions: What is the difference between regression testing and smoke testing?
How do you write a test plan for a new login screen?
Explain how you would test a REST API endpoint.
What is boundary value analysis in software testing?
How do you automate a user login flow using Selenium or Playwright?
sample_JD_text: We are hiring a QA Engineer to ensure software quality. You will write test plans, perform manual testing, build automated test suites using Python/Selenium, and report defects through Jira.

title: Product Analyst
typical_interview_questions: What is retention rate and how is it calculated?
How would you measure the success of a newly launched feature?
Which key performance indicators (KPIs) would you track for an e-commerce platform?
How would you write a query to compute daily active users (DAU)?
Describe a scenario where data contradicted what the product team expected.
sample_JD_text: Seeking a Product Analyst to drive growth. You will analyze product engagement patterns, track KPIs, write SQL queries to understand user behavior, and collaborate with product managers to launch A/B tests.
